subject.title: Feature request: Auto-send intent/acknowledgment text message before agent processing

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported cross-channel text acknowledgement contract before agent processing, and should that contract be a `messages.ackText` config, a generic non-terminal hook, or only channel-specific placeholders?
rationale: This adds new config/API and user-visible channel behavior across multiple plugins, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product surface or compatibility expectations.

options.title: Generic hook plus minimal config
options.body: Add one send-and-continue acknowledgement lifecycle seam and expose minimal opt-in text configuration only where the chosen product contract needs it.

options.title: Channel-specific placeholders
options.body: Keep this issue as an umbrella while landing narrower Slack, Discord, Telegram, WhatsApp, or WebChat placeholder implementations independently.

options.title: Decline text acknowledgements
options.body: Rely on reactions, typing indicators, and channel-native progress surfaces, then close this and channel-specific text-placeholder requests with that decision.

recommendation.title: Generic hook plus minimal config
recommendation.body: Add one send-and-continue acknowledgement lifecycle seam and expose minimal opt-in text configuration only where the chosen product contract needs it.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is recent work on dispatch/source reply delivery and acknowledgement-adjacent channel behavior plus prior review of this exact issue.
